item.title: Local minister says she 'doesn't trust' X
item.description: The Minister for Artificial Intelligence says she doesn't trust the social media platform X. Niamh Smyth met with its representatives earlier this month, and was told the ability of the AI tool Grok to generate naked images of people was being disabled worldwide. However, TD Paul Murphy told an Oireachtas Committee his staff were able to make an undressed image of him on X this morning. item.title: Monaghan business sends staff home due to flooding
item.description: A business owner has said that she had to send staff home today (January 27th) due to flooding in Monaghan Town. Caoimhe Clerkin from Lads and Dads Barbershop in Monaghan Town has told Northern Sound she is "so frustrated" with flooding. Due to Storm Chandra, to entrance to the shopping centre car park, beside the Credit Union, was flooded this morning. item.title: Monaghan resident further remanded in jail over alleged 'human trafficking' offences
item.description: A 57 year old Latvian national who was refused High Court bail on suspicion of human trafficking a woman into the country for the purpose of exploitation has been further remanded in jail. Dainis Grinfelds, with an address at Dublin Street, Monaghan town, was brought before a sitting of Monaghan District Court via video link. item.title: Calls for pedestrian crossing on Oldcastle Rd in Ballyjamesduff
item.description: A local councillor has called on once again the need for a pedestrian crossing on the Oldcastle Rd in Ballyjamesduff. Cllr Trevor Smith said it was something that he has raised before but due to the high volumes of pedestrians on the route he was renewing his call. Cllr Smith said there was a number of facilities on the busy road along with four housing estates. item.title: DPP seeks longer prison sentence for Garda killer Aaron Brady
item.description: The DPP is seeking a longer prison sentence for Aaron Brady than the three years he received for trying to pervert the course of justice during his capital murder trial. The 34-year-old, who’s from Crossmaglen, Co Armagh, is serving a life sentence for murdering Detective Garda Adrian Donohoe during an armed robbery in 2013. item.description: Monaghan County Council has today signed a contract for a €7 million grant. The funding will go towards the St. Louis Chapel redevelopment project. The contact was signed by the Council's Chief Executive, Robert Burns and the Northern and Western Regional Assembly at the Peace Campus in Monaghan. item.title: Major flooding reported across Cavan/Monaghan
item.description: Council crews across Cavan and Monaghan have been working since early this morning as a result of Storm Chandra to clear fallen trees and remove debris from affected routes. Flooding has caused partial collapse of several local roads. This has led to closures, diversions and driving conditions remain challenging in a number of areas. item.title: Over 350 ESB customers without power locally
item.description: There is 358 ESB customers still without power across the Northern Sound region. The whole country is under a status yellow wind warning for the rest of the day as Storm Chandra bears down. Met Eireann has issued the alert for all counties which will remain in place until 11pm tonight.
